title: Persistent State Without Crashes
description: Design principles for durable session state.
body: Restarting a machine should not cost you your workspace. This writes the shell's layout — every window, where it sits, the clusters it holds, the pane trees, the tab order, what was focused — and reads it back at launch. Built to four rules: Never fatal (every read degrades to default), Atomic write (temp file then rename), Forward-compatible (#[serde(default)]), and Not in the repo (config directory, never beside a project). Written on every mutation from inside ShellState::mutate, and never on exit because WindowEvent::Destroyed fires for every window when the app quits.
